chunks: Yet man is sceptical of what is right before him.

key_terms.أَمَامَهُ: Before him / In front of him
key_terms.بَلْ: Yet / But (conjunction indicating contrast or confirmation)
key_terms.لِيَفْجُرَ: To cast forth / To expose / To lay bare

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'man intends to cast forth what is before him' in Surah Al-Qiyamah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as describing the human tendency toward hasty self-destruction or the eager exposure of one's hidden sins before the final reckoning, reflecting a state of spiritual negligence. The phrase 'what is in front of him' (lima qablahu) is viewed by scholars like Allamah Tabatabai as referring to the immediate consequences of one's deeds or the Day of Judgment itself, which man hastens toward through his actions. This highlights the psychological state of the disbeliever who, despite warnings, actively pursues his own ruin.
